headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: August 1, 2026**
article:
The New York Yankees secured a shutout victory over the Chicago Cubs, with Will Warren pitching 6.2 innings of scoreless baseball. Spencer Jones led the Yankees' offense with a home run and 1 RBI. In other news, the Cincinnati Reds edged out the Pittsburgh Pirates 8-7 in a closely contested matchup, while the Philadelphia Phillies dropped a 4-6 decision to the Baltimore Orioles.

Injuries and availability impacted several teams, with the Pittsburgh Pirates placing Ryan O'Hearn on the 10-day injured list due to a left quad strain. The Seattle Mariners also placed Luke Raley on the 10-day injured list retroactive to July 31, 2026, with a left forearm strain. The Minnesota Twins transferred Mike Paredes from the 15-day injured list to the 60-day injured list due to a left oblique strain.

Several trades and roster movements took place, including the New York Yankees trading RHP Camilo Doval to the Pittsburgh Pirates for C Omar Alfonzo and OF Luis Cruz. The Cleveland Guardians traded C Bo Naylor and RHP Codi Heuer to the Milwaukee Brewers for CF Blake Perkins and RHP Craig Yoho. The Baltimore Orioles traded RHP Dean Kremer to the Minnesota Twins for OF Jhomnardo Reyes.

top_news.title: **Yankees Shut Out Cubs 2-0**
top_news.summary: The New York Yankees secured a shutout victory over the Chicago Cubs, with Will Warren pitching 6.2 innings of scoreless baseball, striking out 7 batters and allowing 4 hits. Spencer Jones led the Yankees' offense with a home run and 1 RBI.

top_news.title: **Reds Rally Past Pirates in Thrilling Finish**
top_news.summary: The Cincinnati Reds edged out the Pittsburgh Pirates 8-7 in a closely contested matchup. Sal Stewart led the Pirates' offense with 2 hits, 1 home run, and 4 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Phillies Fall Short in Baltimore**
top_news.summary: The Philadelphia Phillies dropped a 4-6 decision to the Baltimore Orioles in their latest matchup. Pete Alonso led the Phillies' offense with a 2-hit, 1-home run performance, while Andrew Painter pitched 6 strong innings, striking out 6 and allowing 2 earned runs.

top_news.title: **Cardinals Fall to Blue Jays 3-1**
top_news.summary: The Toronto Blue Jays took down the St. Louis Cardinals 3-1, securing a crucial win. Luis Urías led the Cardinals' offense with a single, 2 RBI, and 1 AB.

top_news.title: **Cardinals Fall to Blue Jays 5-1**
top_news.summary: The St. Louis Cardinals suffered a 5-1 loss to the Toronto Blue Jays in their recent matchup. Impact hitters for the game included Jordan Walker, Alec Burleson, Blaze Jordan, Vladimir Guerrero Jr., and George Springer.

top_news.title: **Mariners Edge Twins in Thrilling 4-3 Victory**
top_news.summary: The Seattle Mariners took down the Minnesota Twins 4-3, securing a crucial win in their matchup. Logan Gilbert led the Mariners' pitching staff, while Trevor Larnach and Brooks Lee had notable performances for the Twins.

top_news.title: **Pirates Place Ryan O'Hearn on 10-Day Injured List**
top_news.summary: Pittsburgh Pirates right fielder Ryan O'Hearn has been placed on the 10-day injured list due to a left quad strain.

top_news.title: **Yankees Acquire OF Luis Cruz in Trade**
top_news.summary: The New York Yankees made a move on August 1, 2026, acquiring outfielder Luis Cruz from the Pittsburgh Pirates. Cruz joins the Yankees in exchange for right-handed pitcher Camilo Doval.
